question: Should this branch be salvaged as a freshly rebased Telegram-only extraction, or closed and replaced because the current head mixes unrelated changes and is dirty against main?
rationale: The intended refactor direction is clear, but deciding whether the broad current branch is worth preserving requires maintainer ownership of merge scope and current-main overlap.

options.title: Refresh as Telegram-only
options.body: Rebase or cherry-pick the extraction onto current main, remove every unrelated change, fix any surviving regressions, and rerun proof on the refreshed head.

options.title: Close and recreate
options.body: Close this branch and open a new narrow PR if isolating the extraction would be clearer than repairing the current merge history.

options.title: Review the broad branch
options.body: Keep the full branch only if owners of every affected surface explicitly accept the combined behavior, dependency, workflow, and upgrade risk.

recommendation.title: Refresh as Telegram-only
recommendation.body: Rebase or cherry-pick the extraction onto current main, remove every unrelated change, fix any surviving regressions, and rerun proof on the refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Telegram history and the linked refactor direction make steipete the strongest available owner for deciding whether to preserve or recreate this branch.
